sections.content: You know the modal verbs of guessing *poder*, *deber de* and *tener que* from B2 Unit 26: *poder* is the least sure, *deber de* is a good guess from signs, *tener que* is nearly certain, and *haber* + a participle takes them into the past. A report chooses among them to show how sure it is of a result. You know *tratarse de* ("to be a case of") from B2 Unit 27. This lesson adds *deberse a* ("to be due to") for naming a cause, and both work well after a modal verb. Choose the weakest verb the data allow, and use *no poder* to rule a cause out.

sections.title: From nearly certain to ruled out
rows: Tiene que haber un error en la medición.
There must be an error in the measurement. (nearly certain)
Debe de tratarse de un error de medición.
It must be a measurement error. (a good guess from the data)
El cambio puede deberse a la temperatura.
The change may be due to the temperature. (possible)
No puede deberse a la temperatura.
It cannot be due to the temperature. (ruled out)

items.spanish: Los datos no coinciden: tiene que haber un error en la medición.
items.english: The data do not match: there must be an error in the measurement.

items.spanish: La masa no sube; debe de faltar levadura.
items.english: The dough does not rise; yeast must be missing.

items.spanish: El aumento puede deberse a la temperatura del laboratorio.
items.english: The increase may be due to the temperature of the laboratory.

items.spanish: No puede tratarse de un error: se repitió la medición tres veces.
items.english: It cannot be an error: the measurement was repeated three times.

items.spanish: Tiene que haber sido un error de medición.
items.english: It must have been a measurement error.

sections.content: *Tener que* + an infinitive can be a need (*Tiene que medir*) or a guess (*Tiene que haber un error*): a state verb or *haber* + a participle after it signals a guess. A report should not claim more than the data show: if the data only point to a cause, write *debe de* or *puede*, not *tiene que*. And *deberse* always takes *a*: *puede deberse a la temperatura*.
